en: Colorized historic street view showing a fenced Gothic-style monument with statues in a small square at a street intersection. Surrounding it are multi‑story European buildings with green roofs and dormer windows. The sky is tinted blue and peach in typical early color postcard style. Printed German text at the top identifies the location as Freiberg in Saxony and names the monument and street (Schwedendenkmal and Peterstrasse).
